_comment: Branches that must NEVER be swept, even when their PR is merged.
Read by the portfolio merged-branch sweep. An ABSENT file means 'no declared
exceptions', which is NOT the same as 'no exceptions' - it means nobody asked.
This file is baracuda's answer to having been asked.
Each entry must carry a REASON that is checkable by someone who did not write
it. 'It seemed important' is not a reason; a measurement is.

retained.reason: The ONLY ref in this repository that reproduces the PUBLISHED alpha.79 crate. Measured 2026-09-09: crates/baracuda-cuda-emit/src/cuda.rs is 16523 lines on this branch and byte-identical to the served crates.io tarball after CRLF normalisation; origin/main is 18498 lines and differs. See issue #107 - 'alpha.79' currently names two different artifacts, and this branch is the in-repo record of which one was served. Deleting it makes the collision diagnosable only by re-downloading from the registry.
retained.verify: git show release/v0.0.1-alpha.79:crates/baracuda-cuda-emit/src/cuda.rs | wc -l  ->  16523, matching the served tarball; origin/main gives 18498
retained.review_when: When #107 is resolved by adopting post-publish version bumping, this branch stops being the sole record - the next published version will not collide with the tree. Re-evaluate then, not before.
